verdict.rationale: Smithery's token-scoping docs describe service tokens restricted to connections whose `metadata.userId` matches a specific end user, so a token can only list and call tools on that user's connections. Smithery also manages per-connection OAuth, encrypted credential storage and automatic token refresh, which together cover per-user connected accounts acting only on that user's credentials. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the workflow for creating and tagging a separate connection per end user (only implied through the metadata filter), and independent or hands-on corroboration of tenant isolation.
